title: observability: token-level KV cost/latency metrics + dashboards + alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
commits: 9a7b3d4 — instrument: add token.kv.cache_hit_rate and token.kv.cache_latency_ms metrics
4c2f1a0 — observability: add token cost-per-token emission and tagging by model/route
b6d9e71 — monitoring: grafana dashboard and alert tuning for token-level KV cost/latency
description: Motivation: We observed blindspots in KV cache behavior impacting per-token latency and cost attribution. Several SRE/customer reports (SUP-4021) and ongoing ENG work (ENG-2145) required token-level KV metrics, clearer dashboards, and more robust alerting to reduce noisy pagers. This PR implements: 1) New metrics emitted from the serving runtime: token.kv.cache_hit_rate (tagged by model, route, region), token.kv.cache_latency_ms (histogram), token.cost_per_token_usd (gauge aggregated per request), and token.cpu_ms (for correlation). 2) Dashboard: a Grafana dashboard (deploy/monitoring/grafana/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.json) with panels for cost/latency breakdown by model/route, KV hit-rate heatmap, p50/p95/p99 token latency histograms, and request-level cost waterfall. 3) Alerts: tuned alert rules (deploy/monitoring/alerts/token_kv_alerts.yaml) to avoid noisy pages by switching to 15m evaluation windows for cost regressions, using sustained-rate alerts for KV hit-rate drops, and adding regression suppression for deploy windows. 4) Tests and CI: unit tests for metric emission (pkg/telemetry/emitter_test.go) and a lightweight smoke check used by CI (scripts/ci/observability-smoke.sh). 5) Docs: docs/observability/token-metrics.md explains new metrics, recommended dashboards, and runbook for investigating token-level cost spikes. Backwards compatibility: metrics are additive; tagging follows existing conventions. Rollout: metric emission gated behind feature flag OBS_TOKEN_KV which is enabled for internal canaries and will be rolled out to all clusters after 48h. Rollout plan and Linear links: ENG-2145, ENG-2181. Checklist: - [x] Metric instrumentation implemented - [x] Dashboard and alert definitions added - [x] Unit + smoke tests added - [x] Documentation updated - [x] Alert thresholds tuned with SRE during canary Observability impact: This surfaces per-token KV cache behavior and ties it back to unit economics so product and SRE can prioritize caching/quantization optimizations.
